User's complaint about newly-signed-up users not appearing in Admin Panel is resolved by (i) 2s polling, (ii) custom event dispatched from register(), (iii) storage-event listener, (iv) focus/visibilitychange listeners, (v) newest-first sort placing the just-signed-up user at the top.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminPanel.jsx L112-138: LIVE-TRACKING useEffect is well-structured — subscribes to storage + custom event + focus + visibilitychange + 2s polling, and cleans up all 5 listeners on unmount. No leaks.

AdminPanel.jsx L370-373: UsersSection useMemo now depends on `tick` prop (passed from parent), so any refresh() OR any of the 5 tracking mechanisms invalidates the memo. This addresses the previous iteration's UNBAN-stale-UI bug root cause pattern.
AdminPanel.jsx L167-183: tab-badge-users and tab-badge-verify compute fresh counts on every render (no memoization), so counts are always live. Good.
AuthContext.jsx L120: register() dispatches `trycash:users-changed` inside try/catch — safe for SSR/unsupported browsers. Good.
Sort by createdAt DESC uses `(b.createdAt || 0) - (a.createdAt || 0)` — handles missing createdAt (fallback 0), no NaN risk.
The 5th mechanism (polling every 2s) is a heavy safety net; consider clearing when the users tab is not active to save CPU — MINOR/optional.

AdminPanel.jsx file is ~741 lines and covers three large sections (Exchange, Users, Verify) plus modals; recommend splitting into 3 files (AdminExchange.jsx / AdminUsers.jsx / AdminVerify.jsx) for maintainability. Not blocking.

rca_of_the_issue: USER ISSUE ('newly-signed-up users don't show in Admin Users tab') — ROOT CAUSE ANALYSIS: Prior to this fix, the Users list was memoized on `[modal]` state only and had no refresh trigger for background localStorage changes made by register(). So when a user signed up on another tab/window (or even the same tab but before the admin panel remounted), the admin's memoized users array remained stale. FIX APPLIED: (1) parent AdminPanel subscribes to 4 signals (storage + custom event + focus + visibilitychange) plus a 2s poll — each bumps a `tick` counter. (2) tick is passed to UsersSection and included in its useMemo deps, guaranteeing re-computation. (3) register() dispatches the custom event so same-tab refresh is instant. (4) List is sorted by createdAt desc so newly-added users appear at TOP not bottom. VALIDATION: All four independent triggers (polling, custom event, storage event, manual button) each successfully surface a newly-added user without any admin interaction — verified by TEST 3, 4, 9, 10 in this iteration.
